title: KGN Water Suppliers
shortDesc: Commercial water supplier portfolio showcase & stock inventory management app.
problem: KGN needed a modern digital presence to capture B2B supply contracts and a streamlined internal interface to track daily container dispatches.
whatWeBuilt: Designed and deployed a responsive portfolio platform showcasing commercial water supply services combined with an internal stock tracking panel.
honestScopeNote: Scope focused on responsive client portfolio presentation and internal stock management rather than online payment gateway integration.
